title: Blue Indigo Beauty Tomato - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Rare Purple/Blue Tomato
description:
Tomato ‘Indigo Blue Beauty’
 

 Indigo Blue Beauty is a cross between Beauty King and a wild blue tomato, producing highly distinctive, eye-catching fruits. When exposed to direct sunlight, the tomatoes develop deep blue to purple shoulders due to high anthocyanin levels, while the base ripens to a rich crimson red, creating a striking two-tone appearance.


 Fruits are medium-sized beefsteak type, typically weighing around 120–200g. They have a smooth skin, are resistant to cracking and sunburn, and hold well on the vine over an extended period.


 The flavour is sweet, juicy, and well-balanced with mild acidity. For best taste, fruits should be left to fully ripen on the vine, as they undergo significant colour and flavour development during maturation.


 This is an indeterminate (cordon) variety with vigorous growth, producing reliable crops over a long season. Suitable for greenhouse cultivation or warm, sunny outdoor conditions.


  Key Features:
 

  Medium beefsteak fruits (120–200g)
 

  Blue-purple shoulders with red base when ripe
 

  High anthocyanin content
 

  Sweet, aromatic flavour
 

  Crack and sunburn resistant
 

  Indeterminate, long cropping season
 

  Suitable for greenhouse or outdoor growing
